message.content:
There are \(6! = 720\) ways to arrange the 6 distinct beads in the \(2 \times 3\) grid before considering symmetries.

A \(2 \times 3\) rectangle has exactly \(4\) symmetries:
- identity
- \(180^\circ\) rotation
- horizontal reflection
- vertical reflection

For any nontrivial symmetry, because all beads have distinct colors, no arrangement can be fixed: any nontrivial symmetry swaps at least one pair of positions, which would require the two swapped positions to have the same color.

So every equivalence class consists of exactly \(4\) arrangements.

\[
\frac{720}{4}=180
\]

The answer is 180.
